🌍 US leaders’ defeats extend from battlefield to ballot box: Expediency Council chief

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Chairman of Iran’s Expediency Council Ayatollah Sadeq Amoli-Larijani has described the defeat of US President Donald Trump and Republicans in the midterm elections as humiliating, saying the series of defeats suffered by US leaders has extended from the battlefield to the ballot box.

On the occasion of Aban 13, the National Day of Fighting Global Arrogance, Amoli-Larijani said on his X account on Wednesday that this year’s Aban 13 marked the culmination of a series of defeats for US leaders, extending from the battlefield to the ballot box, as the president and his party lost control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives.
​
He added that the US president had acknowledged Iran’s role in this defeat but said he would repeat the war again.
​
The chief of the Expediency Council pointed out that such a reaction reflects the same sinister arrogance that the Iranian nation has steadfastly opposed—a power that disregards international law, ignores human conscience, and now even overlooks the votes of its own citizens.
​
Amoli-Larijani stressed that although the record of the political faction that has now taken control of Congress, like that of its rival, suggests that it will largely maintain the same foreign policy course, the latest election was a resounding “no” to US warmongering policies and amounted to a kind of referendum on them.
​
He added that if the victorious party is willing to learn from the outcome, it will heed the message of this referendum and clearly recognize the consequences of warmongering.

🔊 Iran won’t allow enemy miscalculations to undermine its security, dignity: First VP

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s first Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref has reiterated that Iran will never allow the enemy’s miscalculations to undermine the country’s security and dignity.

In a post on his X account on Wednesday, referring to an earlier message from the Leader of the Islamic Revolution on the occasion of the 13th of Aban — the National Day of Fighting against Global Arrogance, Aref wrote that the message “offers a clear picture of the end of the myth of arrogance.”
​
The vice president noted, “We pledge allegiance to the Leader of the Revolution; the government, relying on the ironclad will of the people, will not allow the enemy's miscalculations to undermine the security, economy, and civilizational dignity of the Islamic Republic of Iran.”
​
“The dignity and prosperity of this people are our red line,” he stressed.
​
In a message on the day, on the occasion of the 13th of Aban — the National Day of Fighting against Global Arrogance — Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, called national unity, solidarity, and social cohesion key factors for success that he said must underpin every word and action, individually and collectively at every level.
